newsitem.title: UK: KEPIT says TREG shows lack of value.
newsitem.headline: KEPIT says TREG shows lack of value.

text.p: Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc (KEPIT) said on Tuesday that a clarification statement issued earlier by predator TR European Growth Trust Plc (TREG) has exposed "the lack of firm value behind TREG's claims."
In a statement, KEPIT said the amount of its portfolio which it intends to sell under its own plans will be lower than under TREG's proposals.
KEPIT said it intends to arrange a competitive auction for any sales and to "pursue other ways of maximising value including possible direct sales to institutions."
On Monday TREG said it had acceptances equivalent to 2.8 percent of KEPIT ordinary shares and 2.3 percent of issued warrants by 1400 GMT on Sept 13, and extended its offer to October 4.
